descriptions.d25c_spawn_group_at_800e5da0: Allocate a group id. Read the record named by the argument; on a negative status return 0. If the record is-a 0x803678d8 use its name list, else spawn once. For each: read the named record if listed, choose the type key from mode +304 or flag +414, create the spawn (object +28), load it by name, copy the 12-byte position to +68, store the group at +104, OR the flags into +152, store the float at +36, and register its owner (virtual +20 of table +228) with 0x80164514 and the owner id. Returns the group id.
